summary: QXO, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding its wholly owned subsidiary's issuance of $3.0B in senior notes (6.500% 2031 Notes and 6.875% 2034 Notes) to finance its proposed acquisition of TopBuild Corp. Proceeds are held in escrow pending acquisition consummation; notes are secured by escrow property until release. The filing details terms, security, and special mandatory redemption provisions. Watch for regulatory clearance, shareholder approval, and financing conditions; risk-arb centers on deal closing timeline and note performance.
